proofs.text: Write one passing runtime proof entry for `PROOF-2` in a project at the gate `passed` and verify its passed cell reads `passed` with source `local`, `current` true and `counts` true
Write and commit a record whose runner is `ci` in which `PROOF-2` passes at the head commit; verify the passed cell reads `passed` with source `ci`

rule_text: The passed cell reads `passed` when every proof of the rule has a passing test from a source that counts under the gate and that pass describes the current checkout, and it carries the source, whether the pass is current and whether it counts

tests.body:
def test_a_local_run_meets_level_one_under_the_passed_gate(self, project):
        project.proofs([_entry('PROOF-2', 'RULE-2')])
        cell = project.cell('RULE-2', 'passed')
        assert cell['word'] == 'passed'
        assert (cell['source'], cell['current'], cell['counts']) == (
            'local', True, True)
tests.name: test_a_local_run_meets_level_one_under_the_passed_gate

def test_a_ci_record_at_head_meets_level_one(self, project):
        project.record([{'id': 'PROOF-2', 'rule': 'RULE-2', 'status': 'pass'}],
                       ci=True)
        cell = project.cell('RULE-2', 'passed')
        assert cell['word'] == 'passed'
        assert cell['source'] == 'ci'
tests.name: test_a_ci_record_at_head_meets_level_one
